description: Opens a Zillow or Redfin search in a new, visible tab in the user's Chrome and waits (up to 20 s) until DoorMeter has read its homes. Give a search "url", or "site" and a five-digit "zip" with optional price and bed limits. Redfin applies the limits to the search itself; Zillow's search opens without them, so pass the same minPrice, maxPrice and minBeds to search_results. Returns the tab id and how many homes it has. Then call search_results. Calling it again opens another tab.

url.description: A Zillow or Redfin search page URL (not a single listing).

name: open_search
